summary.definition: 52wk high/low >= 2.5 AND price in top 30% of range
summary.caveat: Balance-sheet features are CURRENT (post-move); valuation lifts are a conservative lower bound. Event-signal lifts (insider/MD&A/forced-seller/buyback/hidden-asset) are closer to point-in-time. One-year survivorship sample; lifts inform GEOMETRY_WEIGHTS by hand, not auto-applied.
